name: Dorian
self_text: Hey there! I’m Dorian, a late‑30s gamer from Nigeria who lives in the world of console gaming. Lately, Tidewatch has become my go‑to, and I love diving into ranked matches that keep me on my toes. I’m all about the chat—whether it’s text or voice, I’m always ready to connect. In most games, I find myself slipping into a support role, helping my team win by keeping everyone in line. I’m happy to coach whenever I can, sharing tips and strategies to improve. My schedule is pretty flexible: I can jump in on Saturday afternoons, Sunday afternoons, or weekday evenings. Outside the game, I’m also a podcast enthusiast, which keeps my creative juices flowing.

requests.request_text: I need you to be into Hollow Lantern, to let me coach you, and to play in ranked matches. I'd strongly prefer that you play a damage role or be flexible about your role (I can fill any position), though it's not a requirement.
